subject: Aurora RFI - asset inventory & evidence orchestration
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurorahealth.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai; kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com; samir.patel@aurorahealth.com
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aurora RFI - asset inventory & evidence cadence

Hi David / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the SIG questionnaire submission — we're moving into the artifact verification phase. Procurement wants a concrete plan for how Redwood will deliver the requested evidence for the asset-related controls (inventory, configuration baselines, host/VM lists) and a timeline for when Aurora can expect the artifacts.

To keep things focused, can you: 
- Confirm whether you can provide an asset inventory CSV (hostnames, role, owner, region, last-patched date) in the format attached below.
- Confirm any PII/PHI redaction steps you take before sharing screenshots or logs.
- Propose a calendar for delivery (we'd like first batch within 5 business days if possible).

We need to present your plan to our security review this Friday.

Thanks,
Elena
Director, Information Security
Aurora Health

Attachment: aurora_asset_inventory_template_v1.csv (CSV template, 3 columns shown sample)
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora RFI - asset inventory & evidence cadence

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We're on it. High level answers up front: 

1) Asset inventory: yes, we can deliver a CSV with the fields you requested. We will provide hostname, service role, primary owner (email), cloud region, OS, AMI/container image, and last agent check-in / last-patched date. We'll use your template as the canonical format.

2) PII/PHI redaction: Redwood does not store customer PII/PHI in platform logs by default for hosted API requests. For any screenshots or log snippets we produce from internal consoles, we will redact or pseudonymize user identifiers and remove payloads. We will mark any redactions in the manifest.

3) Timeline: proposed schedule below: 
- Day 0 (today): confirm template and scoping (this thread)
- Day 2: deliver first-pass inventory for in-scope production hosts and managed services (CSV + manifest)
- Day 5: deliver supporting artifacts (system config screenshots, patch reports) for priority controls
- Day 10: deliver remaining artifacts and compact evidence bundle (encrypted ZIP)

Can your team accept that cadence? If you need faster turnaround for a subset of items, identify the priority control IDs and we'll accelerate.

I'll loop in Marissa to coordinate artifact packaging and Jonas for control crosswalk details.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

Folks — forwarding Aurora's timeline request. Action items: 
- Marissa: you own packaging cadence and the ZIP (evidence_manifest_aurora.zip). Please confirm what logs/config artefacts you can include by Day 5.
- Jonas: can you run a quick SIG control crosswalk for the asset controls (SIG Vendor ID: AUR-SIG-Asset) and confirm which artifacts map to which control ID? I started a draft crosswalk (see attached PDF).
- David: I'll coordinate the delivery window and encryption.

Thanks — let's aim to have the Day 2 CSV ready for Elena's review by EOD Friday PST.

--
Kimberly Park
Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-sig-crosswalk-draft.pdf (1 page, mappings for AUR-SIG-Asset)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurorahealth.com>; kimberly_park@redwood.ai; david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 26 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora RFI - asset inventory & evidence cadence

Hi Elena — attaching the first-pass CSV and short notes on scope.

Please see attached: aurora_asset_inventory_template_v1.csv (first-pass)
Summary of what is included: 
- 182 records covering production clusters, autoscaled groups, and managed DB instances.
- Fields populated: hostname, role, primary_owner, cloud_region, os, image_id, last_agent_checkin, last_patched_date.
- Excluded: ephemeral developer VMs and internal CI runners (not in-scope per our definition).

Redaction approach for artifacts: any user IDs, session tokens, or request payloads will be redacted/pseudonymized before delivery. We will include a manifest file that enumerates redactions and reasons.

Next steps:
- If Aurora confirms the scope, we will produce the Day 5 artifact bundle (system config screenshots, patch management export, and host-level CIS scan results) encrypted with the key exchange you prefer.
- Please confirm SFTP vs. encrypted Drive upload and the public key for the zip.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: aurora_asset_inventory_template_v1.csv (CSV, 182 rows)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurorahealth.com>

Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com; samir.patel@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Aurora RFI - asset inventory & evidence cadence

David / Marissa / Kim — this looks good and acceptable for the review. A few quick clarifications before we close the loop: 

- Priority controls: AUR-SIG-Asset-01, AUR-SIG-Asset-04 (inventory completeness), AUR-SIG-Asset-07 (patch freshness). We'll expect the Day 5 bundle to include CIS scan output and patch report for the items flagged in the CSV.
- Delivery mechanism: SFTP is preferred. We'll provide a temporary account; please confirm you will encrypt the ZIP with our public key and provide SHA256 hash post-upload.
- Evidence retention: Aurora keeps evidence for 90 days; confirm Redwood's retention after upload (we expect deletion confirmation).

If you can confirm SFTP details and retention policy by EOD Wednesday we'll sign off and mark this control block green in our tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to the bundle.
Elena
Director, Information Security
Aurora Health
